brief: The long game: 6 compounding habits that separate 20-year careers from 2-year sprints.

slots.subtitle: Six quiet disciplines that transform short ambition into a legacy of enduring influence and mastery.

slots.body: Small actions repeated without spectacle outperform sporadic bursts of genius. The calendar favors those who treat craft as a covenant, not a mood.
In an economy of noise, the ability to do deep work is an unspoken luxury. Guard your focus as jealously as a treasury, for it compounds in silence.
Careers are not built on contacts collected, but on trust accumulated over years. Invest in people before you need the return; capital follows character.
A reputation is the only asset that appreciates while you sleep and collapses in an afternoon. Treat it as your most illiquid and precious holding.
The market rewards those who can defer gratification longer than their competitors. Time is the final arbitrage; those who wait with intent win.
Curiosity is the hedge against obsolescence in a world that rewrites its rules overnight. Read widely, think deeply, and remain eternally teachable.
Mastery is not a milestone. It is a practice. Begin today.
